|quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Herald of Purity''' is a [[Herald]] [[skill gem]]. When activated, it [[Mana reservation|reserves mana]] for a [[buff]] that grants more [[physical damage]] for [[attack]]s and [[spell]]s. It also summons a friendly [[Monster:Metadata/Monsters/Axis/AxisEliteSoldierHeraldOfLight|Sentinel of Purity]] [[minion]] when the player kills an enemy or on hitting a {{c|rare|rare}} or {{c|unique|unique}} enemy while active. ==Skill functions and interactions== * Sentinels: Sentinels of Purity use regular melee attacks, as well as an [[Skill:HeraldOfLightMinionSlam|area of effect attack]]. They can also use [[Skill:SentinelHolySlam|Crusade Slam]], which deals area of effect damage in a cone in front of them. * [[Support Skill Gems|Support Gems]]: Any support gem that can apply to a melee attack as well as a minion, such as {{il|Melee Physical Damage Support}}, {{il|Multistrike Support}}, or {{il|Melee Splash Support}}, will apply to the attacks and abilities of Sentinels of Purity. This will result in a higher mana reservation, in which case, using a {{il|page=Circle of Guilt (Synthesised)}} with "{{c|mod|Herald of Purity has x% increased Mana Reservation Efficiency}}" may be wise. Sentinels '''cannot''' be supported by {{il|Curse on Hit Support}} (to for example apply an curse on enemies). * The summoned Sentinels of Purity's stats scale heavily with the gem level of '''Herald of Purity'''. For example at gem level 20 they have a base [[physical damage]] of 834 to 1,251 (before the inherent "{{c|mod|Minions deal x% more Physical Damage}}" modifier) with a total [[life]] of 5,025 per Sentinel (before the inherent "{{c|mod|Minions have x% more Life}}" modifier), while at gem level 15 their base physical damage is 501 to 752 with a total life of 2,930 per Sentinel. ** {{c|mod|Minions have #% more Maximum Life}} and {{c|mod|Minions deal #% more Physical Damage}} only apply to Sentinels of Purity; it does not affect other minions. * Sentinels have 40% [[Resistance|Elemental Resistances]] and 20% [[Resistance|Chaos Resistance]] by default. * Sentinels have a base attack time of 1.20. * Sentinels can be supported by {{il|Guardian's Blessing Support}} and another [[aura]] skill gem, but do note that [[aura]] buffs can be inconsistent due to the Sentinel's limited duration and life; However, this can be mitigated by having high speed to continually hit rare or unique enemies to refresh the Sentinels. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = More Physical

Life |c3_header = Minions have x% more Maximum Life |c3_pattern_extract = Minions have (%d+)%% more Maximum Life |c3_pattern_value = %d%% }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Ruthless mode== Herald of Purity cannot be obtained from [[quest]]s or traded for using an {{il|Uncarved Gemstone}} through [[Siosa]] in [[Ruthless mode]]. {{Skill enchantment modifier list|query=mods.generation_type=10 AND (mods.stat_text_raw LIKE "%Herald of Purity%" OR mods.stat_text_raw LIKE "%Sentinels of Purity%")}} ==Related unique items== The following [[unique item]]s are related to Herald of Purity: {{Drop enabled unique item table |where = items.stat_text LIKE "%Herald of Purity%" OR items.stat_text LIKE "%Summoned Sentinel%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ==Related passive skills== The following [[passive skill]]s are related to Herald of Purity (this list does not included notables that affect all type of [[Herald]]): {{Query base passive skills |q_where=passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Herald of Purity%" OR passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Sentinel of Purity%" OR passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Summoned Sentinel%" }} ==Related modifiers== These [[List of Searing Exarch implicit modifiers|Searing Exarch]] implicits can be found on some items dropped by the Searing Exarch or Exarch-influenced monsters, and can also be crafted via Searing Exarch currencies. Some high tier mods require {{il|Orb of Conflict}} to craft (These datamined tiers are counted from the bottom. Ie, T6 is the highest tier):
{{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%Herald%of%Light%" AND mods.generation_type = 28 |stat_text=1 |level=1 |spawn_weights=1 |q_orderBy=mods.id ASC }}
==Video demonstration== {{#ev:youtube|e_p56Pxy0Ww|350}} {{Alternate skill effect list|query= items.class_id="Microtransaction" AND cosmetic_items.cosmetic_type LIKE "Skill Gem Effect" AND ( BINARY items.name LIKE "%Herald of Purity%" OR BINARY items.description LIKE "%Herald of Purity%" OR items.description LIKE "%your herald becomes%" OR BINARY items.name LIKE "Invisible Buff Effect" ) }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Quality now causes Minions to have 0-40% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate, instead of providing 0-20% increased Minion Movement Speed. }} {{Version history table row|3.19.0| * The damage and life scaling values for minions have been adjusted. Generally speaking, minion life and damage is unchanged in the very early game, roughly 30% lower in mid acts, roughly 20% lower at level 20 of the minion skill, and roughly 10% lower at level 30 of the minion skill. * Sentinels of Purity now deal approximately 15% more Damage at all levels. Sentinels' Crusade Slam skill now has a 5 second cooldown (previously 6 seconds) and 100% more Area of Effect (previously 80%). }} {{Version history table row|3.16.0| * Sentinels of Purity summoned with Herald of Purity now have 40% less Life. * Because of base Ignite damage changes, Ignite with the skill is now 50.0% higher when using the Death Wish skill from the Maw of Mischief Unique Helmet. }} {{Version history table row|3.11.0| * No longer grants added Physical Damage with Spells and Attacks. * Now grants 9% more Physical Damage at gem level 1, up to 12% more Physical Damage at gem level 20. }} {{Version history table row|3.8.0| * Summoned Sentinels can now use Crusade Slam regardless of Ascendancy. Previously, this required a specific Guardian notable. }} {{Version history table row|3.5.0| * Minions summoned by this skill now deal more Physical Damage based on gem level, rather than more Damage. }} {{Version history table row|3.4.3f| * Now has a chance to summon a Sentinel of Purity when you hit a Rare enemy. }} {{Version history table row|3.4.0| * Herald of Purity has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Navbox Skills}}
